title: GTA6 Limited Edition PS5 Controllers Revealed at State of Play
description: Sony's latest State of Play showcased major PS5 updates, headlined by the official announcement of the GTA6 Limited Edition PS5 Controllers releasing on November 19.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA6 Limited Edition PS5 Controllers Headline Sony's State of Play Showcase

In a massive double-feature event combining a general showcase with a State of Play Japan broadcast, Sony delivered a wave of exciting updates for the PS5 ecosystem. Among the sea of trailers, release dates, and new game announcements, the biggest highlight for fans of Rockstar's upcoming masterpiece was the official reveal of the **GTA6 Limited Edition PS5 Controllers**.

According to the announcement, the highly anticipated custom hardware is scheduled to launch on **19th November**. While exact design specifics were kept under wraps during the broadcast, the confirmation of a concrete release date gives collectors and fans a firm target as they gear up for the next evolution of open-world gaming.

### A Packed Showcase of PS5 Announcements

Beyond the GTA6 hardware news, the back-to-back showcases highlighted a diverse lineup of upcoming PlayStation 5 software:

* **Major Sequels and Finales:** The Final Fantasy 7 trilogy is set to conclude in April with loads of new gameplay revealed; *Until Dawn 2* received a confirmed January 2027 release date; and Capcom's massive new expansion for *Monster Hunter Wilds* left viewers stunned.
* **Ghost of Yotei Updates:** Jin Sakai returns as a playable character in *Ghost of Yotei*'s Most Wanted mode, alongside a proper look at the *Echoes of Sekigahara* DLC.
* **Surprises Galore:** Konami surprised everyone with a brand-new 1920s magick action game for PS5, while Double Fine, Marvel's Wolverine, and a slew of other exciting titles rounded out the presentation.

### Editor's Take

Announcing the GTA6 Limited Edition PS5 Controllers during this major State of Play proves that marketing momentum for Rockstar's juggernaut is quietly ramping up. Setting the hardware release for 19th November positions it perfectly for the holiday season, giving players an ideal way to gear up ahead of the game's ultimate arrival.
